model: ResNet50 (ImageNet IMAGENET1K_V2) fine-tuned for 3-class vehicle damage severity
input: whole vehicle image, RGB; Resize(256), CenterCrop(224), ImageNet mean/std normalisation
selection: Whole-image variant chosen over YOLO-crop variant on validation macro-F1; seed 813 had the highest validation macro-F1 of the three whole-image seeds.
test_note: Reported test results are the 3-seed mean (macro-F1 0.583, accuracy 0.577); this single seed was not selected using test data.
limitations: Trained on 1,059 low-resolution images with subjective labels
Moderate class recall is low (~0.43 on test)
Not validated for real insurance or safety decisions
